sourceText:
Delicious Chocolate Cookies!!!
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Tuesday, December 6, 2011 - 5:56pm

Ingredients




10 Ferro Rocher Candies
3 egg yolks
3 cup flour – sifted
1 cup butter – unsalted - softened
1 tsp. baking powder
1 cup white sugar
½ cup brown sugar
1 tablespoon molasses
¼ cup whole milk

Preparation

1 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 2 In a large bowl combine the softened butter and white and brown sugar. Mix with an electric mixer until smooth. Add the chocolates and mix until well blended and smooth. 3 Slowly add the flour, egg yolks, molasses and milk and combine until a smooth batter is formed. 4 Using parchment paper or non-stick baking pan: 5 Use a teaspoon to place the batter on the pan and gently press down the tops a little. 6 Bake 8-10 minutes.

About

These cookies are easy and very delicious.
With Love,
Catherine
